title: Gekijouban Mahou Shoujo Madoka Magica
justification: Checked by episode title against TVDB series 219181. The films are TMDB movies 152042 (Puella Magi Madoka Magica the Movie Part I: Beginnings (2012)), 152044 (Puella Magi Madoka Magica the Movie Part II: Eternal (2012)), 212162 (Puella Magi Madoka Magica the Movie -Rebellion- (2013)). TMDB show 39218 does not carry it, so the node leaves that show. Anime-Lists leaves episodeoffset empty on this season 0 node, which places no regular episode; offset 0 places them. AniDB episode 1-3 ("始まりの物語" (Part 1: Beginnings) to "叛逆の物語" (Part 3: Rebellion)) are TVDB S0E1 "Madoka Magica the Movie Part I: The Beginning Story" to TVDB S0E3 "Madoka Magica the Movie Part III: The Rebellion Story"; AniDB S1-S4 ("Magica Quartet x Nisioisin 1" to "Magica Quartet x Nisioisin 4") have no TVDB episode (their defaults are other items); AniDB S5-S6 ("劇場版公開記念 2時間でわかる!" (Parts 1 and 2 Summary) to "Madogatari Recap") have no TVDB episode (TVDB has none of them).
